summary: The published gradient can increase its stated objective; the stability proof does not justify an iteration-independent bound; the printed reward reverses its released implementation; the released RL path fails its perturbation cap; and two metric pairs are impossible under the stated definitions.
limitations: No author code, datasets, weights or original experiments were executed.
Repository bytes are a pinned later public commit, not established experiment provenance.
Separate OpenReview supplement access was blocked in source preparation; embedded appendices were available.

Theorem 6.3's literal all-real-weights eigengap premise is infeasible; the stability counterexample is explicitly to the meaningful simplex/squared-mixture interpretation, not a false claim to satisfy that literal premise.
No full benchmark rerun or exhaustive audit of all clustering baselines; later errata search limited to publisher and repository landing pages.

problems.title: Gradient inconsistent with the defined linear kernel mixture
problems.assumptions: Two unit-diagonal PSD 2x2 kernels; K=1; simplex gamma; /N normalization; nonzero uniform feasible eigengap.
problems.result: f increases from .130 to .133. Correct linear-mixture gradient omits 2gamma; squared weights require changing Eq2.
problems.counterevidence: Appendix Eq25 uses squared weights, suggesting intended alternative. A.1 also adds the top-eigenspace term where subtraction is required. No claim all empirical algorithms use this derivation.
problems.impact: Invalid derivation directly defines MKKM-RG and supports central theoretical analysis.
problems.correction: Local correct linear-mixture gradient stated under unique top eigenspace; full theorem repair not verified.
problems.repair_verification: Local correct linear-mixture gradient stated under unique top eigenspace; full theorem repair not verified.

problems.title: Iteration-independent stability is not obtained from the recurrence
problems.claim_location: Theorem6.3 p6; Appendix A.2 p17 Eq34 and final chain
problems.assumptions: Counterexample explicitly uses the natural feasible-simplex and squared-mixture reading; literal all-real gamma premise is impossible at zero.
problems.check: e_{t+1}<=C e_t+C epsilon yields a sum of powers, not a uniform constant. K1=K2=J2 and perturbed K1=[[1,1-eps],[1-eps,1]] have common eigenspace and simplex gap>=(1-eps)/2. eta=.1, gamma0=(.5,.5).
problems.result: e_t=.5[1-(1-eta eps)^t] tends to .5 while noise norm eps tends to zero. A fixed-T O_T(eps) statement survives.
problems.counterevidence: Hidden constants could depend on a prescribed finite T; then the weaker statement is not refuted. Literal impossible premise is not claimed satisfied.
problems.impact: Uniform-over-iterations reading fails, but the theorem permits an admissible fixed-horizon reading. Original theorem-level validity requires clarification of hidden constants and stopping rule.
problems.correction: Geometric recurrence sum and fixed-T bound only; no universal repaired theorem asserted.
problems.repair_verification: Geometric recurrence sum and fixed-T bound only; no universal repaired theorem asserted.

problems.title: Printed reward promotes original-cluster similarity
problems.assumptions: Two orthonormal-column N=4,K=2 representations and original two-cluster co-occurrence; no full constrained-data attack asserted.
problems.check: Preserved grouping gives r=.5; crossed grouping gives r=.25. Maximizing Eq12 with Eq9 prefers preserved grouping.
problems.result: Paper's stated optimization direction differs from released reward 1-r.
problems.counterevidence: Released ClusterEnv and critic both use 1-inter_metric; historical runs may therefore use the intended attack direction.
problems.impact: Core printed attack objective is directionally inconsistent; empirical consequence unresolved.
problems.correction: Negative similarity or 1-r repairs local ordering only.
problems.repair_verification: Negative similarity or 1-r repairs local ordering only.

problems.title: Released RL path does not enforce the perturbation budget
problems.claim_location: Eq3 p3; Eq10 p4; setup p7; ClusterEnv.py205–212; main.py74–82
problems.assumptions: Single environment, reset cumulative noise, positive threshold, sampled action with norm above radius; Gaussian policy has full support.
problems.check: With d=4, thresh=10, radius20, noise(30,0,0,0) is unchanged because 30<20 is false. All released YAML thresholds10 rather than paper .1.
problems.result: Upper-bound guarantee fails for the released core attack operation; nominal scale is100 times the stated default.
problems.counterevidence: Alternate optimization path normalizes; soft mean penalty does not cap sampled cumulative noise. Exact historical table-generating code unknown.
problems.impact: Major for core bounded-attack implementation; historical benchmark effects Needs Evidence.
problems.correction: Projection v min(1,b/||v||) enforces local cap; complete algorithm/experiments not repaired.
problems.repair_verification: Projection v min(1,b/||v||) enforces local cap; complete algorithm/experiments not repaired.

problems.title: Two accuracy/purity pairs cannot share the stated metric definitions
problems.claim_location: Table3 p8 BBCSport JMKSC→MKSSC-ERC; Table5 p19 BBCSport MVC-LFA no attack
problems.assumptions: Same samples/predictions or paired-run averages; one-to-one mapped accuracy and per-cluster majority purity.
problems.check: For contingency counts, max_pi sum_i n_i,pi(i)<=sum_i max_j n_ij. Printed71.73>45.40 and81.88>81.07.
problems.result: At least one metric value or association in each pair is incorrect.
problems.counterevidence: Different unmatched aggregations could evade paired inequality but are not disclosed and require clarification. Two-decimal rounding cannot explain gaps.
problems.impact: Localized reporting error, no established global experimental invalidation.

unresolved.detail: Released evaluation chooses candidate using external metrics; training reward uses predicted labels. Historical provenance and equal treatment of baselines unknown.
